steps.content: Before a sealed door, a sorrowful shadow waits.
She seems to be confessing, or waiting. Confessing her stubbornness and prejudice; waiting for a child who will never again respond to her unspoken love.

steps.speaker: Sorrowful Shadow
steps.content: I was so foolish... I loved you so much... You were... the best child in the world...

steps.speaker: Sorrowful Shadow
steps.content: I didn't want you to be a hero... I didn't want you to carry this... weight... I just wanted you...
The sorrowful shadow blurs, and with her weeping, melts into the darkness.
